name: Verify that the user can reset applied search on transactions
Verify that if user selects "Company" then the label field name should be "Company Name"
Verify that if user selects "Individual" then the label field name should be "Last Name"
Verify that the Create Transaction module is displayed when the user clicks on the "Create Transaction" button.
Verify that all form sections are displayed sequentially on the screen
Verify that the user can expand and collapse the details by clicking on the collapse button.
Verify that the "Show All" tab displays all fields on the form.
Verify that the Show Required tab displays only mandatory fields on the form.
Verify that all required fields must be filled before clicking the "Create" button
Verify that the Transaction screen is displayed correctly with all expected content.
Verify that the user can see the profile options by clicking on the users name
Verify that the user can click on the "Create Transaction" button to create a new transaction
Verify that user can enter to any transaction by clicking on enter transaction icon
Verify the system's response when entering extremely long text (e.g., 10,000 characters) in the 'Company Name' or 'Last Name' field
Verify that the user can apply multiple filters to search for transactions
Verify that the "Branch" dropdown is disabled until a "Group" is selected
Verify that the user can select a group from the "Group" and "Branch" dropdown when creating a transaction.
Verify that the "Customer Type" field allows switching between Individual and Company
Verify that pagination works correctly for navigating through paged content
Verify that Client details section is displayed as expected.
Verify that error message should displayed for Invalid inputs
Verify that the user can view recent transactions by clicking on the "Recent Transactions" button
Verify that the user can search for transactions using the transaction number in Quick access modal
Verify that the user can minimize the search module
Verify that the Hide Overview tab hides the overview section of transaction.
Verify that the Show Overview tab displays the overview section of transaction.
Verify that navbar options are displayed as expected at the top of the screeen.
